items.quote: 8:13 And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.claim: Moses brought Aaron's sons, put coats on them, tied girdles around them and put bonnets on them, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
items.action: brought and clothed (put on coats, girded with girdles, put on bonnets)
items.mechanism: acting on a divine command ('as the LORD commanded Moses')
